spans.s:
‘guṭakā’
Dig. Jain. small unspecified collections of stotras etc. Pannalal Bombay 150 (stotra). 170. 171. 175-81. Pannalal Bombay V. B. p.. 3 (Pkt.). 5. 6. 52.

‘gurumatānuvāda’
mīm. by Timmayajvan of Mādhava Somayājin's family (a. of Kṛṣṇābhyudayakāvya an. C., Adyar D.
; also NCC. V. p. 16b); ref. to along with Kṛṣṇābhyudaya, a. the work of his grandfather by Timmayajvan or Tirumalayajvan in the intro. verses of his Darśapūrṇamāsamantrabhāṣya,

‘guhyatamamantrāḥ’
on the application of esoteric mantras. by Śaṅkara of Vasiṣṭhagotra an. Rājakula family in Muktisthala (Mūkkola in Kerala) a. explained by his teacher Dāmodara, son of Nīlakaṇṭha of Kuṇḍālaya (Trikkantiyur).

‘guhyānukramaṇī’
Bud. on mystic significance of syllables ? Cambr. Uni. Bud. p. 186.

‘gūḍhaprakāśinī’
name of Appayya Dīkṣita's C. on Ādityastotraratna, Trav.
